description: Assess whether a domain (or the domain of an email address) can receive mail and how strong its sender authentication is. Returns MX presence, SPF and DMARC policy, whether it's a free consumer provider (gmail, etc.) or a known disposable/temp-mail provider, and an overall verdict. Use to qualify leads and flag throwaway signups.

domain_or_email.description: A domain (stripe.com) or an email address (a@stripe.com)
